name: Bilateral Snapdown
instructions: Stand or kneel with arms overhead holding a light weight or a band with both hands.
Brace your abs and snap your arms down quickly toward your hips.
Finish with a strong ab contraction and ribs pulled down.
Return slowly to the overhead position.
Keep your lower back from arching at the top.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A fast core exercise where you drive a held overhead position down to your hips, training the abs to produce force.

commonMistakes: Letting the weight yank your shoulders
safetyNotes: Start light; do not force the overhead position if your shoulders feel tight.
